label: PF Backlog 145
title: Canonical id index: ONE format-independent id query for every consumer (+ manifest)
body:
Problem: spec ids (FR/NFR/US + local families) were parsed by several modules with DIFFERENT regexes (output_checklist, nfr_coverage, progress, compliance_check, agent_runner, agent_requirements, integration_advisor, test_matrix, traceability), so the same id could be seen differently and detection depended on LLM formatting (headings vs tables vs bullets vs bold).

DONE: new core/id_index.py — single reader for config/spec-id-families.json, format-independent token extraction (FR-1/FR1/FR_1/**FR-1**/| FR-1 |/### FR-1), normalize/ids/iter_ids/scopes/defined_in_scopes/duplicates/counts. Rewired: nfr_coverage, progress, output_checklist.id_families (delegates). Gate now validates table-style feature files cleanly (0 undefined) and surfaces 16 REAL duplicate US ids in docs/requirements.md.

REMAINING: migrate the other consumers (compliance_check, integration_advisor, test_matrix, traceability/requirement_link) to id_index so every search/operation uses the SAME query. DURABLE UPGRADE: emit a machine-readable requirements manifest (id -> feature) from the design stage and validate against it, removing prose heuristics for definitions/duplicates entirely.

dashboard_impact.reason: Backend/parse-layer only; no new dashboard surface.

_note: All id consumers centralized on core/id_index (hubs: output_checklist, nfr_coverage, progress, compliance_check, traceability). Verified grep: 0 ad-hoc FR-/NFR-/US- regexes left in core. Machine-readable manifest = traceability.json id_index (single source). wired_audit=0.
